canDoYue: 你識講訂房、非吸煙房、行李留喺櫃檯、四點之後房間準備好，同埋喺前台攞無線網絡密碼。
canDoEn: Ask for a non-smoking room, leave the luggage at the desk, come back after four when the room is ready, and take the wifi password from a card at the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello, I have a reservation, and I hope our booked room is ready very soon.
dialogue.glossYue: 你好，我有訂房，希望我哋訂咗嘅房間就快準備好。
dialogue.say: Hello, I have a reservation, and I hope our booked room is ready very soon.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The room is not ready, and your luggage can stay beside the desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 房間未準備好，行李可以放喺櫃檯旁邊。
dialogue.say: The room is not ready, and your luggage can stay beside the desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we please have a non-smoking room, and may the luggage stay here?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以要非吸煙房，行李留喺度得唔得？
dialogue.say: Could we please have a non-smoking room, and may the luggage stay here?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The non-smoking option is free for you, and it is ready after four o'clock.
dialogue.glossYue: 非吸煙房唔使加錢，四點之後房間就準備好。
dialogue.say: The non-smoking option is free for you, and it is ready after four o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: What is the wifi password I can use when I reach the room?
dialogue.glossYue: 我入到房間可以用嘅無線網絡密碼係咩？
dialogue.say: What is the wifi password I can use when I reach the room?

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: The wifi password is printed on this card you can take from the front desk.
dialogue.glossYue: 無線網絡密碼印喺呢張卡，你可以喺前台攞。
dialogue.say: The wifi password is printed on this card you can take from the front desk.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will leave the luggage at the desk and then come back after four o'clock.
dialogue.glossYue: 我會將行李留喺櫃檯，四點之後再返嚟。
dialogue.say: I will leave the luggage at the desk and then come back after four o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: kim
dialogue.text: Please come back for the room after four, and the desk will call your name.
dialogue.glossYue: 請四點之後返嚟取房間，櫃檯會叫你個名。
dialogue.say: Please come back for the room after four, and the desk will call your name.
